meta.name: Neymar The Perfect Chaos
meta.description: Beloved worldwide but also a lightning rod for criticism, Neymar shares the highs and lows of his personal life and brilliant football career.

videos.title: This is Paris
videos.overview: As tensions rise with PSG, Neymar takes a step back to rediscover his love for the game and to make a difference in many lives back in his hometown.
